analyst_view.overall: Sparta Prague (22nd, 4 pts) host AZ (14th, 6 pts) at Letna in turmoil: after a 1-3 home defeat to Liberec, Sparta sacked Brian Priske and his assistants on Monday, and with no new coach named, Lukas Blaza and youth coach Miroslav Droppa took Tuesday's training. Sparta have won one of their last nine games and are without defender Tobias Guddal, banned after two yellows against Bournemouth and scorer of two of their six European goals, which the numbers do not count, plus the injured Karabec, Rynes, Uchenna and Penxa, with Eneme and Sochurek ill. AZ won 5-1 at Sparta Rotterdam at the weekend despite missing Kees Smit, Patati, Schouten and Resink, all expected out until after the winter break, while Hornkamp's hamstring is unclear; the numbers count Schouten and Hornkamp and AZ's recent form. Portuguese referee Antonio Nobre is in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals (AZ 1.7) and know nothing of Sparta's coach being sacked three days before kick-off or of Guddal's ban, which takes a scorer out but also weakens their defence. A low-confidence side under caretakers against an AZ attack that just scored five points to a slightly more open game, so I go to about 3.1; a possible reaction from the players keeps it small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, mostly AZ (5.7), already up a little for Sparta conceding many corners lately. The upheaval changes who coaches Sparta but not obviously how the game is played for corners, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already raised for Sparta's recent bookings (15 in six) and trimmed for referee Antonio Nobre's short, calm record. An angry home crowd could add tension, but Sparta also lose Guddal, who was sent off in their last European game, so I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots, already up about 12% for AZ's busy recent shooting (100 in six). Sparta's turmoil could tilt the game further toward AZ, but the numbers already have AZ well ahead on shots, and AZ are without Smit and Patati, so I stay at 26.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. With Sparta's back line short of Guddal and the team in disarray after the sacking, AZ should get a few cleaner chances, so I go slightly higher, to about 9.1.
